name: Athaliah
summary: Omri's daughter and the mother of Ahaziah king of Judah. When her son died, she killed the royal family and ruled the land for six years until she was overthrown.

key_moments.title: Killing the Royal Family
key_moments.description: When her son Ahaziah died, Athaliah destroyed all the royal heirs. But young Joash was stolen away and hidden in the LORD's house for six years while she ruled.

key_moments.title: Overthrown and Killed
key_moments.description: Hearing noise in the temple, Athaliah came and saw the young king standing by a pillar while the people rejoiced. She tore her clothes, crying out that it was treason, and she was taken out and killed.
